Based on the screenshot:

**1) Map:** Yes, a full-screen map is visible. It shows roads (white lines with labels like "ARCOT RD", "INNER RING RD", "MOUNT MALL...", "KUR R LAKE"), a light blue lake area on the left ("...UR LAKE"), green park blobs, and area labels like KOYAMBEDU, VADAPALANI, and MANAPAKK. Map style is a light/cream tone.

**2) Pins:** Yes, all present:
- **Bus stop pins:** dark maroon/black pins with bus icons (several near center)
- **Metro pins:** dark square badges with a white "M" (Koyambedu, Vadapalani, and several on the right side)
- **Railway pins:** green/teal square badges with train icons (right side and upper area)
- **User location:** blue dot with a white walking-person icon and pulsing light-blue circle in the center

**3) Floating controls:**
- Top-left toggle pills: "Bus Stops" (ON, blue), "Metro Stns" (ON), "Railway Stns" (ON) — each with a switch
- Top-right circular white close "X" button
- Bottom-right circular white locate button (crosshair icon)
- A small "N" compass badge at the very bottom-left corner

**4) Bottom sheet:** Yes — a white rounded bottom sheet contains:
- "You are in ↗ **Ramapuram**." with "No buses available around you."
- A pink-to-orange gradient search bar: Search "Bus, Metro, Train" with a magnifier icon
- Below: icon tiles (bus, train illustrations) and a white pill nav bar with Home (active, red), Tickets, Bus Ticket (elevated blue circular button), Pass, Account

**5) Glitches/overlaps:**
- Text labels are cut off at screen edges ("KUR R LAKE", "ARCOR RD", "MOUNT MALL", "MANAPAKK") — clipping rather than broken
- The highlighted blue "Train" chip inside the search bar looks like a slightly odd overlay
- The "N" compass badge slightly overlaps the bottom nav area/edge of the sheet
- The central user pin slightly overlaps two bus stop pins — minor crowding, but nothing looks functionally broken
